answer: A convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is a bond-and-epoch system: each agent identity posts a small time-locked deposit, an ember stake, before it can vote, trade, or earn fees, and the deposit is refunded only after several honest epochs with no fraud. An attacker minting cheap sparrow-like fake agents must lock real capital in every one, and forfeits it when any identity misbehaves. Like umber stains that never wash out, sustaining a swarm of phony identities becomes a guaranteed loss instead of a profitable flood.
